requested_outcome: Add stable all-business and canonical family filters to the VII conversion report, release the complete frozen candidate, and verify the public and authenticated natural destinations.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co and the authenticated VII business-performance administration report
authorization_boundary: Code changes, tests, exact candidate publication and post-deploy verification are authorized. DNS, secrets, external messages, destructive data operations and real bookings remain unauthorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user requires a complete tested public result rather than code-only completion.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact deployed version must pass public, admin and rollback checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: The changed surface is an operational administration report.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Loading, empty, error, permission, persistence and visible filter behavior are separate gates.

lesson_bundle.reason: Several raw world identifiers must behave as seven canonical business families.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Aliases must normalize without lost or duplicate businesses.

lesson_bundle.reason: The report combines VII analytics with supplier conversions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every metric keeps source, scope, period and truthful availability semantics.

lesson_bundle.reason: The release also contains the previously prepared multilingual sitemap and crawl repairs.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Public sitemaps, canonical, hreflang, robots and redirects must be rechecked after deployment.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user expects the administration surface to match the platform-level space visual system.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact deployed report and administration shell require visual inspection.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The family list is derived from current rows, so empty families disappear.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a stable canonical registry for all seven families plus all businesses.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every option remains visible with zero, one or many matching rows.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Aliases such as vacation/vacations or room/hourly split one family.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Normalize raw world values before filtering.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Contract tests prove every alias maps to exactly one requested family.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Families unsupported by the Biz supplier endpoint are shown as if supplier conversions exist.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep VII report filtering available for every family while presenting Biz aggregates only for supported business targets.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Unsupported families show an honest empty/unavailable supplier state without fabricated totals.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The release publishes unrelated dirty files or a different build than the tested commit.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Stage only owned files, commit, push that SHA, package its build and save/deploy that exact SHA.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Sites version provenance, archive and deployed SHA agree and rollback identity is recorded.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Local tests pass but production still has old sitemap/admin/report behavior.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run bounded post-deploy public and authenticated checks on the exact release.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public URLs and authenticated report visibly expose the released behavior with no critical regression.

affected_family: authenticated business performance and conversion report
vacation, events, spa, hourly rooms, activities, trails and providers family filters
date basis, date range, business search, sorting and CSV export
VII analytics rows and Biz conversion aggregates
multilingual sitemap, canonical, hreflang, robots and legacy redirect candidate changes
desktop and mobile public release smoke paths

midpoint_gate.trigger: After canonical family filtering and focused tests pass, before full build and publication.
checks: All eight filter choices are present.
Every alias maps to the intended family.

attack_questions: Can a family disappear when it has no activity?
Can an alias leak into the wrong family or duplicate a business?
Can unsupported Biz data appear as zero rather than unavailable?
Can the deployed SHA differ from the tested candidate?
Can the SEO candidate regress after the report change?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public production URLs plus authenticated administration report after deployment.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, full suite/build, Sites provenance, public SEO smoke and report-state checks.

effectiveness.baseline: The report currently derives domain options from the selected period and supports supplier conversions only for individual vacation, event and room businesses.
effectiveness.target: Deliver one stable release in which all requested families are always filterable and no unsupported supplier total is invented.
